HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
